arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Gilley argued the case involves a small subset of Rule 52(b) cases.
Mr. Wall emphasized the need for a contemporaneous objection.
Justice Scalia questioned how the Court would decide whether to take such a case.
Justice Kennedy noted the number of presented cases could be substantial.

paragraphs: The outcome defines the scope of appellate review for legal errors. It determines how courts handle records that lack clarity. It affects the finality of lower-court decisions. It shapes the burden on litigants to preserve issues.
